items.title: 川普下油價預言！期中選舉後將暴跌、美伊戰爭也會告終
items.title_en: Trump Predicts Oil Price Crash After Midterms and End of Iran War
paras: 美國總統川普周三(9日)表示，受美伊戰爭影響而居高不下的油氣價格，恐怕要等到期中選舉結束後才會回落，並預言伊朗戰事也將在選後「立即」告終。
據CNBC報導，川普在前往德州出席共和黨期中選舉大會前告訴記者：「選舉一結束，油價就會開始暴跌。」距離美國期中選舉目前已不到兩個月。
川普發表上述談話之際，美國與伊朗的敵對行動再度升溫，推動國際油價進一步走高。全球基準布蘭特原油期貨自7月以來首度突破每桶101美元，美國西德州中級原油期貨盤中高點也升破96美元。
美伊戰爭目前已進入第七個月，但仍看不到明確的解決跡象。儘管川普過去多次宣稱美國已在這場戰爭中取得勝利，他周三仍堅稱，戰事將在期中選舉結束後立即落幕。
當記者追問這項預測的依據時，川普表示，伊朗「已經無法再支撐下去」，但隨後又指控德黑蘭刻意拖延戰事，希望藉此影響美國選舉結果。
川普稱，伊朗正拚命試圖左右選舉，希望讓一群「軟弱的人」取得權力，以便美國政府不再施壓，甚至放任伊朗擁有核武。不過，他並未提出證據支持這項說法，也未進一步解釋油價與戰爭為何會在選後迅速逆轉。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday (the 9th) that the high oil and gas prices caused by the Iran‑U.S. war are unlikely to fall until after the midterm elections, and he even forecast that the conflict with Iran would end "immediately" after the vote.

According to CNBC, Trump told reporters before heading to Texas for the Republican midterm convention that "once the election is over, oil prices will start to plunge," noting that the U.S. midterms are now less than two months away.

At the time Trump made those remarks, hostile actions between the United States and Iran were heating up again, pushing international oil prices higher. The global benchmark Brent crude futures broke above $101 a barrel for the first time since July, and U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude reached intraday highs above $96 a barrel.

The Iran‑U.S. war is now in its seventh month with no clear signs of resolution. Although Trump has repeatedly claimed the United States has already won the war, he reiterated on Wednesday that the fighting will end immediately after the midterms.
When pressed for the basis of his prediction, Trump said Iran "can no longer sustain itself," and then accused Tehran of deliberately dragging out the conflict to influence the U.S. election outcome.

Trump claimed Iran is desperately trying to sway the election by helping a group of "weak people" gain power so that the U.S. government will stop applying pressure and even allow Iran to possess nuclear weapons, though he offered no evidence and did not explain why oil prices and the war would reverse so quickly after the election.

items.title: 邊打伊朗邊賺石油財？川普能源持股帳面最高增值440萬美元
paras: 美國總統川普主導美伊戰爭與停火決策期間，其個人投資帳戶仍持續買賣能源股。美國財經媒體《CNBC》周三(9日)獨家分析顯示，戰爭爆發前夕至8月底，川普9大油氣持股帳面增值約150萬至440萬美元，交易時點與多項足以撼動市場的政策宣布相互重疊，再度引發利益衝突爭議。
《CNBC》根據川普年度財務申報、企業季報及FactSet市場數據估算，從戰爭前夕2月27日至8月31日，川普持有的9家主要油氣公司股價均受惠油價與能源股上漲。
不過，由於申報資料未揭露確切股數、成交價格及賣出哪些股份，上述數字僅為依申報價值區間推算的帳面增值，不代表已實現獲利或目前精確持股。《CNBC》也未發現川普或其投資經理利用事先掌握的決策資訊交易，或川普的財務利益曾影響政府政策。

9大能源持股因戰爭增值最高440萬美元

川普的9大油氣持股包括雪佛龍(CVX-US)、康菲石油(COP-US)、埃克森美孚(XOM-US)、Kinder Morgan(KMI-US)、Marathon Petroleum(MPC-US)、西方石油(OXY-US)、Phillips 66(PSX-US)、Valero Energy(VLO-US)及Williams Companies(WMB-US)。
根據財務申報，戰爭爆發前，川普對埃克森美孚的投資價值介於320萬至1,250萬美元。截至8月31日，埃克森美孚股價上漲，估計使這筆原始持股帳面增值17.6萬至69萬美元，尚未計入其後買賣。
Raymond James & Associates高級投資策略師Pavel Molchanov表示，戰爭造成史上最大規模的石油供應中斷，油價走勢幾乎完全由此推動。石油是全球性商品，沒有任何人能避開價格上漲的影響。
川普帳戶截至6月29日仍持續買進股票，並申報至少23筆涉及上述9家公司的賣出交易。由於其後交易尚未公開，目前無法得知相關帳戶的最新部位。

攻擊後大買、停火前賣出 交易時點惹議

3月2日，也就是美國與以色列首次攻擊伊朗後的第一個交易日，川普帳戶申報買進8家大型油氣公司股票，其中購入埃克森美孚股票的金額介於10萬零1美元至25萬美元。
3周後的3月23日，川普以雙方進行「非常良好且具建設性的對話」為由，在開盤前延後攻擊伊朗能源基礎設施。布蘭特原油因局勢可能降溫而暴跌近11%。川普帳戶當天申報16筆油氣股買進交易，沒有任何賣出，總金額約16.3萬至57萬美元，包括埃克森美孚、雪佛龍及Phillips 66。
賣出時點同樣引起監督團體關注。4月7日，川普其中一個投資帳戶申報賣出50萬零1美元至100萬美元的埃克森美孚股票。美股收盤約兩個半小時後，川普宣布美伊停火兩周，埃克森美孚隔日開盤重挫逾6%。
若相關股票從戰爭前便已持有，《CNBC》估計，這筆交易不僅避開隔日跌勢，2月27日至賣出前還可能增值3.5萬至7萬美元。但申報文件並未提供買進日期，因此不能視為該筆交易的實際獲利。

白宮否認利益衝突 專家質疑並非盲目信託

白宮發言人Davis Ingle表示，川普及任何家族成員都無法指示、影響或參與投資組合的買賣決策，所有投資均由獨立經理人負責，不存在利益衝突。
川普集團未回應《CNBC》此次置評要求，但先前曾表示，個別投資決策由外部金融機構控制，川普資產存放在全權委託帳戶，且投資策略高度自動化。
政府倫理監督團體則認為，把日常交易交給經理人並未消除根本利益衝突。美國透明國際(Transparency International U.S.)副執行董事Scott Greytak表示，全權委託帳戶只是「煙幕」，並不等於真正的盲目信託；即使川普沒有親自下單，他仍可能知道自己的大筆資金投向能源產業，也會從政府決策推升能源股中獲益。
白宮責任與倫理公民組織(CREW)執行長Donald Sherman指出，總統的官方決策可以影響市場，自己又可能從中受惠，將使公眾難以分辨國家政策與私人財務利益的界線。
川普8月3日還曾公開批評埃克森美孚與雪佛龍利用供應短缺「賺太多錢」，要求兩家公司回饋民眾並降低零售價格，與其帳戶持有兩家公司股票形成強烈反差。
國會聯合經濟委員會民主黨幕僚另一項估算顯示，川普更廣泛的油氣投資組合今年可能增值最多1,550萬美元。多名民主黨議員已表示，若在11月期中選舉取得國會任一院控制權，可能調查川普的股票交易與家族商業活動。

油企獲利增至3倍 美國家庭多付715億美元

戰爭引發的供應中斷為油企帶來意外之財，卻同時提高消費者負擔。川普投資組合中的9家能源公司第二季合計獲利476億美元，是去年同期159億美元的3倍。
其中，埃克森美孚與雪佛龍合計獲利266億美元，高於去年同期的96億美元；Marathon Petroleum、Phillips 66及Valero Energy等3家煉油商，第二季合計獲利也達127億美元。
煉油供應吃緊可能延續。埃克森美孚執行長Darren Woods表示，排除疫情時期，目前煉油產能相對需求的緊張程度是他所見最高，高利潤率也會帶來更高的成品油價格。Phillips 66執行長Mark Lashier則表示，即使戰爭隔天結束，煉油市場仍將維持強勁。
截至上周五，美國原油價格約為每桶91美元，較戰前高出36%；全美汽油均價達每加侖4.09美元。國會聯合經濟委員會民主黨幕僚估算，戰爭爆發以來，美國人已額外支付715億美元汽油費，平均每戶多支出約604美元。
高油價也可能成為共和黨期中選舉的政治負擔。《路透》與益普索(Ipsos)調查顯示，48%美國人將生活成本列為最重要的投票議題，70%不認同川普處理生活成本的方式。
Molchanov指出，戰爭結束後，油價與能源股理應回落，但戰爭何時結束，終究是一項政治決定。這也凸顯川普身兼戰爭決策者與能源產業投資人的敏感處境。

items.title: 蘋果發表會一次看！摺疊iPhone Duo壓軸登場 標準版iPhone 18卻缺席？
items.title_en: Apple Event All in One! Foldable iPhone Duo Takes Center Stage While the Standard iPhone 18 Is Missing?
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)台灣時間周四(10日)凌晨一點舉行秋季新品發表會，新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)首度主持活動，一口氣推出iPhone 18 Pro系列、Apple Watch Series 12、Apple Watch Ultra 4與AirPods 5，並以市場期待已久的首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo壓軸。新機展開後擁有7.6吋螢幕，操作體驗更接近iPad，成為整場發表會最大亮點。
值得注意的是，蘋果此次並未發表標準版iPhone 18。外媒指出，蘋果正調整iPhone推出時程，標準版iPhone 18預料將於明年春季與平價版iPhone 18e、輕薄機型iPhone Air 2一同登場。
另一大焦點iPhone 18 Pro則首度搭載採用2奈米製程打造的A20 Pro晶片，GPU繪圖效能與持續效能均提升40%。投資人對發表會前半段內容反應一度平淡，蘋果盤中股價跌幅曾擴大至1.4%；隨著iPhone Duo正式亮相，跌幅一度收斂至約0.8%，截稿前小跌0.17%，每股暫報315.69美元。

首款摺疊機iPhone Duo壓軸登場

特納斯重現蘋果共同創辦人賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)經典的「One more thing」，壓軸發表蘋果首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo。他表示，對一款在人們生活中扮演核心角色的裝置而言，更大的螢幕將開啟全新可能性，而摺疊設計是實現這項目標的最佳方式。
圖：蘋果
特納斯直言，現有摺疊手機往往像是「兩支手機笨拙地黏在一起」，iPhone Duo則採取不同設計思維，折疊後大小約等同一本護照，展開後的使用體驗則更接近iPad。
iPhone Duo外側螢幕為5.4吋，顯示面積相當於iPhone 18 Pro的90%；展開後的內側螢幕則達7.6吋。機身採用鈦金屬材質，提供星辰白(Star White)與夜空藍(Night Sky)兩款顏色，並將Touch ID整合至側邊按鈕，同時支援空間音訊、Apple Pencil (USB-C)，防塵防水能力符合IP68等級。
圖：蘋果
針對耐用性向來是摺疊手機的一大痛點，蘋果為摺疊螢幕開發客製化奈米紋理塗層，可降低摺痕的可見程度並提升觸控質感；全新螢幕覆蓋層也較競爭產品更加耐用。蘋果強調，新機每次使用都能帶來「堅固扎實」的手感，摺疊螢幕也達到iPhone一貫的品質標準。
蘋果軟體工程主管費德里吉(Craig Federighi)表示，公司針對iPhone Duo重新檢視iOS的各個層面，調整按鈕及其他控制功能的位置。新機操作介面融合iOS與iPadOS特色，App可在開闔裝置時自然切換，並加入方便單手操作的直向App Dock。
iPhone Duo支援App並排多工處理，也能同時開啟同一款App的兩個視窗，直向鍵盤亦經過重新設計，裝置可朝不同方向使用，折疊擺放後還能充當床頭鬧鐘。
圖：蘋果
第三方App也能充分利用兩塊螢幕，例如Slack與Zoom可在一側顯示共享畫面，另一側呈現視訊會議參與者。外媒對新介面給予高度評價，認為蘋果成功改善摺疊手機的操作體驗。
硬體方面，iPhone Duo搭載與iPhone 18 Pro相同的A20 Pro晶片及均熱板散熱系統，並採用蘋果第三款自研行動網路晶片C2，在美國支援5G毫米波。新機在全球市場全面採用eSIM，不提供實體SIM卡槽。
機身兩側各配置一組電池，並可作為單一電池系統共同運作。蘋果表示，使用內側螢幕時可連續播放31小時影片，外側螢幕則可播放44小時；新機支援20分鐘充至50%，充電5分鐘即可播放5小時影片。
圖：蘋果
相機方面，iPhone Duo背面配備4,800萬畫素廣角及超廣角鏡頭，並支援iPhone 18 Pro的新版攝影風格等功能。外側前置相機為1,200萬畫素，內側則搭載螢幕下FaceTime相機。
使用者拍照時可讓外側螢幕顯示取景畫面，協助被攝者調整姿勢；拍攝孩童時，也能在外側螢幕播放影片吸引注意。蘋果另推出iPhone Duo保護殼，以及附有支架的Folio保護套，並將新機形容為初代iPhone問世以來最具變革性的使用體驗。
圖：蘋果
iPhone Duo售價為1,999美元，與市場同類摺疊手機相近，也低於不少華爾街分析師原先預期，將於10月23日正式上市。
台灣方面，10月16日晚上8點開始預訂，10月23日開始發售，售價為新台幣74,900元起。

iPhone 18 Pro搭載首款2奈米晶片

特納斯將蘋果AI策略定位為「Intelligence Personal Hub」，並表示iPhone兼具先進晶片、優質螢幕與相機、全天候電池續航力及跨裝置協作能力，是承載AI體驗的理想裝置。
iPhone 18 Pro與iPhone 18 Pro Max延續前代整體設計，採用與機身顏色相配的背面玻璃，提供深黑色、冰川色、銀色與勃根地紅等選擇，並改善電池續航力及低光源攝影表現。
新機搭載採用2奈米製程打造的A20 Pro晶片，配備6核心CPU及7核心GPU，其中高效能核心速度較前代提升20%，繪圖效能提高40%。晶片另搭載雙神經網路引擎，AI運算效能是前代的2倍，可強化遊戲與人工智慧處理能力，並支援第三方模型直接在裝置端運行。
蘋果也為新機導入次世代均熱板系統，散熱表面積是iPhone 17 Pro的3倍，可協助系統處理更多熱能，使持續效能提升40%。蘋果形容，這是一項「巨大飛躍」。
圖：蘋果
電池續航力同樣大幅升級，iPhone 18 Pro續航時間達36小時，甚至超越前代iPhone 17 Pro Max；iPhone 18 Pro Max則進一步延長至45小時。新機也支援更快速的有線充電，充電5分鐘即可播放6小時影片。
相機方面，新機加入利用AI辨識拍攝主體的「智慧對焦追蹤」功能，即使人物一度離開畫面後再度進入，鏡頭仍能重新鎖定主體並保留細節；新版「攝影風格」則進一步改善色彩及膚質呈現。
錄影功能支援4K縮時攝影，並改善慢動作、電影模式及錄音品質。相機App另加入「Pro Controls」專業控制功能，讓使用者調整白平衡、查看直方圖及手動控制光圈，提供更高度客製化的拍攝體驗。圖：蘋果
因應AI生成內容與進階修圖日益普及，iPhone 18 Pro也加入照片真實性驗證功能及「Apple Reference Image」。系統會在拍攝當下以像素為單位簽署照片資料，形成類似「數位底片」的紀錄，協助確認照片原始內容。蘋果表示，本次發表會影片就是使用iPhone 18 Pro的軟硬體拍攝。
動態島也迎來2022年推出以來首次重大更新，不僅顯示範圍縮小，還能同時呈現3項即時動態。iOS 27另加入讓同一電話號碼跨兩支iPhone使用的iPhone Handoff、可調整的Liquid Glass介面，以及多項效能改善。
iPhone 18 Pro起售價為1,199美元，iPhone 18 Pro Max則自1,299美元起，均於9月12日開放預購，9月18日正式上市。
台灣於9月12日晚上8點開始預訂，9月18日開始發售，兩款手機售價分別為新台幣44,900元、49,900元起。

Apple Watch強攻AI健康管理

蘋果同步發表Apple Watch Series 12與Apple Watch Ultra 4，鎖定健康、運動追蹤及AI功能，並導入重新設計的「Health Sensing System」健康感測系統。
新系統增加電極數量，以提升心電圖(ECG)讀取效果；同時重新設計光電二極體，並採用面積更大的綠色LED，提高心率及全天候健康追蹤的準確度，即使使用者正在移動也能持續監測。蘋果宣稱，新款Apple Watch擁有所有穿戴式裝置中最精準的心率感測能力。
圖：蘋果
Vitals App也迎來重新設計，加入心率變異度(HRV)等數據；全新Readiness App則會整合睡眠及其他健康資訊，評估使用者當天的身體承受能力並給出分數，協助判斷何時適合積極運動、何時應該休息。
蘋果還推出「健康年齡」功能，根據睡眠、心率變異度及其他生物指標評估使用者的身體年齡。重新設計的Health App則能利用AI產生個人健康摘要，並可透過iPhone相機分析運動表現，進一步提供健康洞察。
新版Health App預計今年稍晚率先在美國推出，初期僅支援英文。蘋果在美國也將與Quest合作，以119美元提供實驗室檢測服務。
「Audio Intelligence」功能可在iPhone不在身邊時辨識嬰兒哭聲、門鈴及警報器等聲音；「Live Rewind」則能回溯15秒，重新呈現使用者在對話中未聽清楚的內容。
另一項主要功能「Siri Recaps」可透過環境聲音感知，為使用者每天的對話建立重點摘要，並能在Apple Watch的Siri App或其他蘋果裝置上查看。蘋果也推出Siri Modular Face錶面，讓使用者快速啟動Siri及閱讀摘要；Siri Recaps預計今年稍晚以測試版形式推出。
新款手錶搭載S11晶片負責處理音訊，並設有全新「Secure Exclave」安全區域管理原始音訊資料，以降低環境聲音處理帶來的隱私風險。裝置內另有一款以A20 Pro為基礎打造的新晶片，蘋果稱其為公司歷來效能最強大的穿戴式裝置晶片。
續航力方面，Apple Watch Ultra 4可使用超過兩天，較前代明顯提升；Apple Watch Series 12則維持24小時。兩款產品售價均與前代相同，並將於9月18日上市。
外媒指出，健康年齡及長期健康評估等功能並非全新概念，Whoop與Oura早已朝相同方向發展，因此蘋果此次更像是在追趕競爭對手，整體而言，今年Apple Watch硬體升級幅度相對有限。
台灣Apple Watch Series 12於9月11日上午9點開始預訂，9月18日開始發售，售價為新台幣13,900元起；Apple Watch Ultra 4售價則為新台幣27,900元起，預定與發售日期與前者相同。

AirPods 5登場 降噪能力提升50%



蘋果也發表AirPods 5，強調新耳機能針對更多不同耳形提供更豐富、細緻的音質，主動降噪效果較AirPods 4提升50%，讓外界聲音進入的通透模式也更加自然。
AirPods 5可透過iPhone使用Siri AI及即時翻譯功能，機身也經過重新設計，提高防雨、防塵能力。開啟主動降噪時，電池續航力最長可達4小時。
AirPods 5基本款售價129美元，已包含主動降噪功能；高階版本售價149美元，另提供類似AirPods Pro的滑動音量控制、最長5小時電池續航力及無線充電盒。兩款均於9月18日上市，蘋果稱其為歷來最出色的「開放式AirPods」
台灣AirPods 5於9月11日上午9點開始預訂，9月18日開始發售，售價為4,490元起。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) held its autumn product launch at 1:00 a.m. Taiwan time on Thursday the 10th, with new CEO John Ternus hosting the event for the first time. The company unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro series, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and AirPods 5, and capped the show with the long‑awaited first‑ever foldable iPhone Duo. The new device features a 7.6‑inch screen that offers an experience closer to an iPad, making it the highlight of the entire event.

It is noteworthy that Apple did not announce a standard iPhone 18 this time. Foreign media reported that Apple is adjusting its iPhone rollout schedule, with the standard iPhone 18 expected to appear next spring alongside a budget iPhone 18e and a slim‑line iPhone Air 2.

The iPhone 18 Pro is also a major focus, debuting Apple’s first 2‑nanometer A20 Pro chip, which boosts GPU graphics performance and sustained performance by 40%. Investors reacted rather mutedly to the first half of the event, and Apple’s intraday share price fell as much as 1.4%; after the iPhone Duo was unveiled, the decline narrowed to about 0.8%, and by the time of writing the stock was down 0.17%, trading at $315.69 per share.

The first foldable iPhone Duo takes the stage

Ternus recreated co‑founder Steve Jobs’s classic “One more thing” moment to unveil Apple’s first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo. He said that for a device that plays a core role in people’s lives, a larger screen will unlock new possibilities, and a folding design is the best way to achieve that goal.
Image: Apple

Ternus bluntly said that existing foldables often feel like “two phones awkwardly stuck together.” The iPhone Duo follows a different design philosophy: folded, it’s about the size of a passport; unfolded, its usage feels more like an iPad.

The iPhone Duo’s outer display is 5.4 inches, covering roughly 90 % of the iPhone 18 Pro’s screen area; the inner display expands to 7.6 inches when opened. The body is made of titanium and comes in Star White and Night Sky colors. Touch ID is integrated into the side button, and the phone supports spatial audio, Apple Pencil (USB‑C), and IP68‑rated dust‑ and water‑resistance.
Image: Apple

Addressing durability—a traditional pain point for foldables—Apple developed a custom nano‑texture coating for the folding screen that reduces the visibility of creases and improves tactile feel; the new screen cover layer is also more robust than competing products. Apple emphasized that each use feels “solid and sturdy,” and the folding screen meets Apple’s usual iPhone quality standards.

Software engineering SVP Craig Federighi said the company re‑examined every layer of iOS for the iPhone Duo, adjusting button placement and other controls. The new interface blends iOS and iPadOS features, allowing apps to transition naturally when the device is opened or closed, and adds a vertical App Dock optimized for one‑handed use.

The iPhone Duo supports split‑screen multitasking and can open two windows of the same app simultaneously. The vertical keyboard has been redesigned, the device can be used in either orientation, and when folded it can serve as a bedside alarm clock.
Image: Apple

Third‑party apps can fully exploit the two screens; for example, Slack and Zoom can show shared content on one side while displaying video‑call participants on the other. Foreign media praised the new interface, saying Apple has successfully improved the foldable phone experience.

Hardware‑wise, the iPhone Duo shares the same A20 Pro chip and vapor‑chamber cooling system as the iPhone 18 Pro, and uses Apple’s third‑generation in‑house cellular modem C2, which supports 5G mmWave in the United States. The device is eSIM‑only worldwide and does not include a physical SIM slot.

Two battery packs sit on either side of the chassis and can operate together as a single power system. Apple says the inner screen can stream video continuously for 31 hours, while the outer screen lasts 44 hours; a 20‑minute charge gets the phone to 50 % and a five‑minute charge provides five hours of video playback.
Image: Apple

Camera-wise, the iPhone Duo’s rear module includes a 48‑megapixel wide‑angle and ultra‑wide‑angle lens and supports the new photographic styles introduced with the iPhone 18 Pro. The outer front camera is 12 megapixels, while the inner front camera is under‑display FaceTime.

When users take photos, the outer screen can display the viewfinder to help subjects adjust their pose; when photographing children, the outer screen can play video to capture their attention. Apple also launched a protective case for the iPhone Duo and a Folio case with a built‑in stand, calling the device the most transformative user experience since the original iPhone launched.
Image: Apple
The iPhone Duo is priced at $1,999, comparable to other foldable phones on the market and lower than many Wall Street analysts had expected. It will be available for purchase on October 23.
In Taiwan, pre‑orders begin at 8 p.m. on October 16, with sales starting on October 23 at a starting price of NT$74,900.

iPhone 18 Pro features the first 2‑nanometer chip

Ternus positioned Apple’s AI strategy as an “Intelligence Personal Hub,” noting that the iPhone, with its advanced chip, premium display and camera, all‑day battery life, and cross‑device collaboration, is the ideal platform for AI experiences.

The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max retain the overall design of the previous generation, using rear glass that matches the body color and offering options such as Deep Black, Glacier, Silver and Burgundy Red, along with improved battery life and low‑light photography performance.

The new devices are powered by the 2‑nanometer A20 Pro chip, featuring a six‑core CPU and a seven‑core GPU. The high‑performance cores run 20 % faster than the previous generation, and graphics performance is up 40 %. The chip also includes dual neural‑engine cores, delivering twice the AI compute power of its predecessor, enhancing gaming and AI workloads, and supporting third‑party models to run directly on the device.

Apple also introduced a next‑generation vapor‑chamber cooling system, with a heat‑dissipation surface three times larger than that of the iPhone 17 Pro, allowing the system to handle more thermal load and boosting sustained performance by 40 %. Apple described this as a “huge leap.”
Image: Apple

Battery life sees a major upgrade as well: the iPhone 18 Pro can last up to 36 hours, surpassing the iPhone 17 Pro Max, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max extends to 45 hours. Both models support faster wired charging, with a five‑minute charge delivering six hours of video playback.

Camera upgrades include an AI‑driven “Smart Focus Tracking” that locks onto a subject even if it leaves the frame and returns, preserving detail, and an updated “Photographic Styles” feature that further refines color and skin‑tone rendering.

Video capabilities now support 4K time‑lapse, improved slow‑motion, cinematic mode and better audio capture. The Camera app adds a “Pro Controls” suite, letting users adjust white balance, view histograms and manually set aperture for a highly customizable shooting experience. Image: Apple

In response to the rise of AI‑generated content and advanced editing, the iPhone 18 Pro adds a photo‑authenticity verification feature and an “Apple Reference Image” system. The phone signs each photo at the pixel level at capture time, creating a “digital negative” that helps verify the original content. Apple noted that the event video itself was shot using iPhone 18 Pro hardware and software.

The Dynamic Island receives its first major update since its 2022 debut, shrinking its display footprint while simultaneously showing three real‑time activities. iOS 27 also adds iPhone Handoff for using the same phone number across two iPhones, a customizable Liquid Glass interface, and numerous performance enhancements.
The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, and the iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at $1,299. Both became available for pre‑order on September 12 and launched on September 18.
In Taiwan, pre‑orders began at 8 p.m. on September 12, with sales starting on September 18. The two models are priced from NT$44,900 and NT$49,900 respectively.

Apple Watch pushes AI‑driven health management

Apple simultaneously unveiled the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, targeting health, fitness tracking and AI features, and introduced a redesigned “Health Sensing System.”

The new system adds more electrodes to improve ECG readout quality; it also redesigns the photodiode and uses a larger green LED to boost heart‑rate and all‑day health tracking accuracy, even while the user is moving. Apple claims the new Watch offers the most precise heart‑rate sensing among wearables.
Image: Apple

The Vitals app gets a redesign, adding metrics such as heart‑rate variability (HRV); the new Readiness app will combine sleep and other health data to assess a user’s daily physical capacity and assign a score, helping decide when to push hard or rest.

Apple also introduced a “Health Age” feature that estimates a user’s biological age based on sleep, HRV and other biomarkers. The revamped Health app can generate AI‑driven personal health summaries and, using the iPhone camera, analyze workout performance to provide deeper health insights.
The new Health app is slated to launch in the United States later this year, initially supporting English only. In the U.S., Apple will partner with Quest to offer lab‑testing services for $119.
The “Audio Intelligence” feature can recognize baby cries, doorbells and alarms when the iPhone isn’t nearby; “Live Rewind” can replay the last 15 seconds of a conversation the user missed.

Another major feature, “Siri Recaps,” uses ambient sound to create daily conversation summaries that can be viewed on the Siri app on Apple Watch or other Apple devices. Apple also released a Siri Modular Face watch face that lets users quickly launch Siri and read summaries; Siri Recaps is expected to arrive later this year as a beta.

The new watch runs on an S11 chip for audio processing and includes a new “Secure Enclave” area to manage raw audio data, reducing privacy risks from ambient‑sound processing. Inside the device is also a new chip based on the A20 Pro, which Apple calls the most powerful wearable chip it has ever built.

In terms of battery life, the Apple Watch Ultra 4 can run for more than two days, a clear improvement over its predecessor; the Apple Watch Series 12 maintains a 24‑hour battery life. Both devices retain the same pricing as the previous generation and will be available on September 18.

Foreign media noted that features such as health age and long‑term health assessment are not brand‑new concepts—Whoop and Oura have pursued similar directions—so Apple’s effort looks more like catching up with competitors, and overall the hardware upgrade for this year’s Watch is relatively modest.

In Taiwan, the Apple Watch Series 12 opens for pre‑order at 9 a.m. on September 11 and ships on September 18, starting at NT$13,900; the Apple Watch Ultra 4 is priced from NT$27,900, with the same pre‑order and launch dates.

AirPods 5 arrives with 50 % better noise cancellation

Apple also announced AirPods 5, emphasizing that the new earbuds deliver richer, more detailed sound for a wider range of ear shapes, and that active noise cancellation is 50 % stronger than on AirPods 4, while the Transparency mode lets ambient sound in more naturally.

AirPods 5 can use Siri AI and real‑time translation via the iPhone, feature a redesigned case with improved water and dust resistance, and provide up to four hours of playback when active noise cancellation is enabled.

The base model of AirPods 5 costs $129 and includes active noise cancellation; the premium version is $149 and adds swipe‑volume control similar to AirPods Pro, up to five hours of battery life, and a wireless charging case. Both models launch on September 18, and Apple calls them the best “open‑type” AirPods ever made.
In Taiwan, AirPods 5 become available for pre‑order at 9 a.m. on September 11 and go on sale on September 18, starting at NT$4,490.

items.title_en: AI Turns Into Real Money! S&P 500 Profit Forecast Expected to Jump 32% This Year, Wall Street Calls for More Gains
paras: 人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮與優於預期的第二季財報，正推動標普500指數企業獲利展望大幅上修。華爾街目前預估，標普500成分股今年獲利將成長32%，高於財報季前預估的24%；巴克萊也將指數年底目標價由7,800點調高至7,950點。
根據彭博彙整的華爾街數據，標普500成分股幾乎都已公布財報，其中86%表現超越分析師預期，為2021年以來最高。LSEG針對已公布財報的492家公司統計也顯示，86%優於預期，遠高於67.5%的長期平均。

AI投資推升獲利 通訊服務成長上看51%

彭博行業研究(Bloomberg Intelligence)分析師Nathaniel Welnhofer表示，2026年大規模AI基礎建設支出，顯然是企業獲利超額成長的主要催化劑。第二季獲利上修速度甚至超越已創紀錄的第一季，打破市場對企業能否滿足高標期待的疑慮。
與AI相關的亞馬遜(AMZN-US)和Alphabet(GOOGL-US)繳出最突出的財報驚喜。通訊服務業獲利預估上修幅度居各產業之冠，今年成長率由第二季初預估的26%大幅調高至51%。
Alphabet受惠廣告收入強勁成長及AI商業化，EchoStar(SATS-US)則在一次性項目挹注下，寫下該產業最大幅度的財報超標表現。即使扣除一次性收益，彭博行業研究分析師Rahul Jain指出，標普500第二季財報仍是歷來表現最強勁的季度之一。

消費、能源與金融接棒 AI成本壓力浮現

非必需消費產業的獲利預估也明顯上修，排除汽車業後，所有子產業均優於預期。亞馬遜獲利更達市場預估的3倍，推動該產業今年獲利成長預測由約12%升至32%。
Target(TGT-US)、沃爾瑪(WMT-US)、TJX(TJX-US)、Ross Stores(ROST-US)及雅詩蘭黛(EL-US)均擊敗每股盈餘預期並上調財測，顯示消費支出依然健康。
科技業持續受惠於企業擴大AI資本支出，但成本逆風逐漸浮現。蘋果(AAPL-US)因記憶體漲價與供應受限，產品等待時間拉長，營收展望不如預期；輝達(NVDA-US)也警告，記憶體成本飆升將壓縮利潤率。輝達、蘋果與微軟(MSFT-US)目前均是標普500權重最高的成分股。
能源業則受惠油價上漲及中東供應中斷程度低於預期。埃克森美孚(XOM-US)與雪佛龍(CVX-US)獲利預估雙雙獲得上調，其中伊朗戰爭推升油價，為埃克森美孚額外貢獻約37億美元獲利。
油田服務商貝克休斯(BKR-US)也因中東戰爭衝擊較小、訂單強勁而上調全年財測，工業與能源科技訂單較去年同期翻倍，創下71億美元新高。
金融業第二季獲利預估小幅調高，強勁資本市場、貸款成長與穩定信用品質可望延續至第三季。固定收益、股票、外匯及大宗商品交易收入，加上併購交易費用，均有望持續增長。

巴克萊上調年底目標 仍警戒AI估值風險

巴克萊將標普500年底目標由7,800點調高至7,950點，較最近收盤價仍有約3.6%上漲空間，並預測指數將在2027年底升至8,800點。該行也把標普500今年每股盈餘預估由337美元大幅調高至365美元。
不過，標普500今年已上漲12.1%，巴克萊對估值仍持保守態度，原因包括AI支出能否長期維持、通膨居高不下、地緣政治不確定性，以及利率展望轉趨鷹派。
巴克萊另將公用事業類股評等由「正面」下調至「中立」，理由是野火責任改革面臨挑戰，部分州也開始反對資料中心建設許可。這顯示AI投資雖然持續推動企業獲利，電力需求帶來的政策阻力也正逐漸升高。
滙豐同樣在周二調高標普500年底目標，看好強勁企業獲利與AI基礎建設支出延續漲勢。瑞銀、高盛與花旗則預測，標普500今年底將收在8,000點或更高水準。
paras_en: AI investment hype and better‑than‑expected Q2 earnings are driving a sharp upgrade to profit outlooks for S&P 500 companies. Wall Street now estimates S&P 500 component earnings will grow 32% this year, up from the pre‑earnings‑season forecast of 24%; Barclays also raised its year‑end target for the index from 7,800 to 7,950 points.

According to Bloomberg‑compiled Wall Street data, almost all S&P 500 constituents have reported earnings, with 86% beating analyst expectations – the highest proportion since 2021. LSEG’s tally of the 492 companies that have reported also shows 86% exceeding forecasts, far above the long‑term average of 67.5%.

AI investment lifts profits; communications services growth looks to reach 51%. Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Nathaniel Welnhofer said massive AI infrastructure spending in 2026 is clearly the main catalyst for excess profit growth. The pace of Q2 profit upgrades even outstripped the record‑setting Q1, easing market doubts about companies meeting lofty expectations.

AI‑related firms Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) delivered the most striking earnings surprises. Communications services saw the biggest profit‑forecast revision among sectors, with its growth rate revised up from an early‑Q2 estimate of 26% to 51% for the year.

Alphabet benefited from strong ad revenue growth and AI commercialization, while EchoStar (SATS‑US) posted the industry’s largest earnings‑beat thanks to a one‑time item. Even after stripping out the one‑off gain, Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Rahul Jain noted that the S&P 500’s Q2 earnings were among the strongest quarters on record.

Consumer, energy and financials take the baton as AI cost pressures emerge. Non‑essential consumer earnings forecasts were also sharply upgraded; excluding autos, every sub‑industry beat expectations. Amazon’s profit came in at three times market estimates, pushing the sector’s annual profit growth outlook from roughly 12% to 32%.
Target (TGT‑US), Walmart (WMT‑US), TJX (TJX‑US), Ross Stores (ROST‑US) and Estée Lauder (EL‑US) all beat EPS expectations and raised guidance, indicating consumer spending remains healthy.

Tech continues to benefit from expanding corporate AI capex, but cost headwinds are surfacing. Apple (AAPL‑US) faces longer product wait times due to higher memory prices and supply constraints, dampening revenue outlook; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) warned that soaring memory costs will compress margins. Nvidia, Apple and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) are currently the highest‑weight S&P 500 constituents.

Energy firms gained from higher oil prices and a milder‑than‑expected disruption in Middle‑East supply. Exxon Mobil (XOM‑US) and Chevron (CVX‑US) both saw profit forecasts lifted, with the Iran‑related war‑driven price rise adding roughly $3.7 billion of profit for Exxon Mobil.

Oil‑field services firm Baker Hughes (BKR‑US) also raised its full‑year outlook, citing a smaller impact from the Middle‑East conflict and strong order flow; industrial and energy‑tech orders doubled year‑over‑year, hitting a new high of $7.1 billion.

Financials’ Q2 profit forecast was nudged higher, supported by robust capital markets, loan growth and stable credit quality that should carry into Q3. Revenue from fixed income, equities, FX, commodities trading and M&A fees are all expected to keep rising.

Barclays lifted its year‑end target to 7,950 points, still about 3.6% above the latest close, and projects the index to reach 8,800 by the end of 2027. The bank also bumped its 2024 S&P 500 EPS estimate from $337 to $365.

However, with the S&P 500 already up 12.1% this year, Barclays remains cautious on valuations, citing uncertainties around the durability of AI spending, persistently high inflation, geopolitical risks and a more hawkish rate outlook.

Barclays also downgraded its rating on utilities from “positive” to “neutral,” noting challenges to wildfire‑liability reforms and growing opposition in some states to data‑center permits. This shows that while AI investment continues to boost corporate profits, policy resistance to rising power demand is also mounting.

HSBC likewise raised its year‑end S&P 500 target on Tuesday, bullish on sustained strong corporate earnings and AI infrastructure spending. UBS, Goldman Sachs and Citi all forecast the index will close the year at 8,000 points or higher.

paras: 日元近期大幅升值，兌美元價位從160一路升破153，然而策略師警告，若日元繼續走強並造成「套利交易」快速平倉，可能引發股市拋售，而高估值的美國科技股將首當其衝。
多年來，華爾街交易員熱愛能「輕鬆賺錢」的「日元套利交易」：以近乎零利率的成本在日本借錢，再把資金投入其他市場追逐更高報酬，主要流向美股市場。
但這項押注如今面臨瓦解風險，近期日元兌美元大幅升值，加上市場普遍預期日本銀行(BOJ, 央行)下周升息，可能重創這項廣受歡迎的交易策略。
日元周二(8日)延續兌美元升勢，盤中一度升破153，最高報152.89日元兌1美元，創2月以來最強。
市場預期日銀下周將大幅升息，成為推動日元上漲的主要動力。市場也開始揣測，日本當局可能再次低調干預外匯市場，以抑制日元近期跌勢。
日元兌美元上周已跌破160整數關卡。160通常被視為關鍵門檻，日元一旦升至這一水準，日本政府干預匯市的可能性將提高。根據FactSet數據，日元兌美元9月迄今已升值近4%。
在此背景下，市場動能可能讓股市投資人暴露在一項意料之外的衝擊中：日元持續升值，進而引發套利交易快速平倉。
所謂套利交易，是指投資人以較低利率借入資金，再投入可能帶來較高報酬的資產。日元套利交易則是借入低收益的日元，買進收益率較高的美元，再將美元投入美國資產，例如科技股。
舉例來說，1年期日本政府公債殖利率約1.55%，1年期美國國庫券殖利率約4.12%，兩者相差約2.57個百分點。換句話說，日元套利交易可藉由這項利差提高投資報酬。
但這項交易也可能以同樣強大的力量反向運作。如果日元突然進一步升值，就像近幾天的走勢一樣，投資人可能被迫迅速解除套利部位。這意味著投資人可能必須賣出以美元計價的資產，再將資金換回日元，以償還以日元計價的借款。
市場不久前就曾承受這種痛楚。2024年夏季日元大幅升值，引發股市震盪，套利交易平倉尤其威脅當時漲勢凌厲的美國科技股。
如今外匯市場可能再次具備類似條件。市場預期日銀將升息，而單是升息預期本身就可能進一步推升日元。
Swissquote資深分析師Ipek Ozkardeskaya表示，這類套利交易平倉「可能對AI／科技股族群造成尤其嚴重的衝擊」，因為高估值與部位過度集中，可能放大潛在的拋售壓力。
她指出，這將為逢低買進創造機會，因為套利交易平倉不會永遠持續，但短期內——可能持續數周，投資人將感受到壓力。
不過，Clocktower Group首席市場策略師Eric Wallerstein認為，這一次日元套利交易出現系統性平倉的可能性不高，因為交易員大多已經預期日元今年還會進一步升值。因此，日元若再突然升值，較不容易讓交易員措手不及，這或許足以避免出現恐慌性的大規模平倉。
Wallerstein表示，只要日本利率仍遠低於全球其他地區，「套利交易就仍會存在」。但若要重演幾年前出現的劇烈震盪，日元必須出現「幅度大且出乎意料」的升值。
2024年夏季套利交易平倉期間，日元兌美元在短短兩個月內升值13%。相比之下，這一次自7月底美元兌日元匯率觸及高點以來，美元兌日元匯率貶值不到6%。
paras_en: The yen has surged sharply lately, climbing from around 160 per dollar to break below 153, but strategists warn that if the yen keeps strengthening and forces a rapid unwind of “arbitrage trades,” it could spark a stock‑market sell‑off, with over‑valued US tech stocks hit first.

For years Wall Street traders have loved the easy‑money “yen arbitrage” play: borrow at near‑zero rates in Japan and deploy the funds into other markets for higher returns, mainly flowing into US equities.

That bet now faces collapse risk as the yen has appreciated sharply against the dollar and markets broadly expect the Bank of Japan to raise rates next week, which could cripple this popular strategy.
The yen continued its rise against the dollar on Tuesday the 8th, briefly breaking the 153 level and peaking at ¥152.89 per $1, its strongest since February.

Markets anticipate a sizable BOJ rate hike next week, the main driver behind the yen’s climb, and are also speculating that Japanese authorities may quietly intervene in FX to curb the yen’s recent rally.

Last week the yen fell below the round‑number barrier of 160 per dollar. The 160 level is seen as a key threshold; once the yen reaches it, the likelihood of government FX intervention rises. FactSet data shows the yen has appreciated about 4% against the dollar so far in September.
Against this backdrop, market momentum could expose equity investors to an unexpected shock: a continuously strengthening yen that triggers a rapid unwind of arbitrage positions.

Arbitrage trades involve borrowing at low rates and investing in higher‑yielding assets. Yen arbitrage means borrowing cheap yen, buying higher‑yielding dollars, and deploying those dollars into US assets such as tech stocks.

For example, the 1‑year Japanese government bond yields about 1.55% while the 1‑year US Treasury yields about 4.12%, a spread of roughly 2.57 percentage points, allowing yen arbitrage to boost investment returns.

But the same mechanism can work in reverse. If the yen suddenly appreciates further, as it has in recent days, investors may be forced to unwind arbitrage positions quickly, selling dollar‑denominated assets and converting the proceeds back to yen to repay yen‑denominated loans.
The market felt this pain not long ago. In the summer of 2024 a sharp yen rally rattled equities, and the unwinding of arbitrage trades especially threatened the then‑soaring US tech sector.
Now the FX market may again present similar conditions. Expectations of a BOJ rate hike alone could further lift the yen.
Swissquote senior analyst Ipek Ozkardeskaya said such arbitrage unwinds “could hit AI/tech stocks especially hard” because high valuations and concentrated positions can amplify sell‑pressure.
She added that this could create buying opportunities on dips, since arbitrage unwinds won’t last forever, but in the short term—potentially for several weeks—investors will feel the strain.

However, Clocktower Group chief market strategist Eric Wallerstein believes the chance of a systemic unwind this time is low, as traders largely anticipate further yen gains this year, making a sudden move less likely to catch them off guard and possibly averting panic‑driven mass unwinds.

Wallerstein noted that as long as Japanese rates remain far below those elsewhere, “arbitrage trades will persist.” Yet to repeat the severe volatility seen a few years ago, the yen would need to appreciate “dramatically and unexpectedly.”

During the summer 2024 unwind, the yen rose 13% against the dollar in just two months. By contrast, since the end of July when the USD/JPY peaked, the dollar has depreciated less than 6% against the yen.

items.title: 貝森特砸60億美元也壓不住！10年期美債殖利率衝上近3年新高
items.title_en: Bessent’s $6 Billion Buyback Can’t Stem the Rise! 10‑Year U.S. Treasury Yield Hits Near‑Three‑Year High
paras: 美國財政部宣布擴大公債回購規模，仍未能阻止殖利率上揚。10年期美債殖利率周三(9日)升至2023年11月以來最高，反映回購規模低於部分華爾街人士期待，加上油價突破每桶100美元，市場對通膨風險的疑慮持續升高。
指標10年期美債殖利率上升逾3個基點至4.839%，盤中觸及2023年11月1日以來最高水準，當時曾升至4.935%。30年期美債殖利率也上升3個基點至5.292%；對短期政策預期較為敏感的2年期殖利率則升逾1個基點至4.415%。債券價格與殖利率呈反向變動。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)宣布，將回購60億美元長天期政府債券，規模相當於一般操作的3倍。貝森特上月曾表示，財政部將把公債回購規模至少提高一倍，希望改善市場流動性。
然而，殖利率在消息公布後仍然走高，原因是部分投資人原本期待更加積極的措施。《The Boock Report》的Peter Boockvar表示，一些華爾街人士原先預估回購規模可能達到70億至80億美元，因此最終結果未能滿足市場期待。
油價同步上漲，也對債市造成壓力。國際指標布蘭特原油期貨自7月底以來首度突破每桶100美元；美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨周三上漲逾3%，升破每桶96美元。
美國與伊朗衝突持續升級。德黑蘭周三表示，伊朗部隊已攻擊波斯灣內2艘美國船隻及8艘油輪，報復美軍摧毀5艘伊朗原油油輪。
ADM Investor Services首席經濟學家兼全球策略師Marc Ostwald表示，利率與外匯市場面臨的環境愈來愈複雜。能源價格居高不下可能擴大通膨壓力，但也會加重經濟成長逆風，甚至造成需求破壞，使政策與市場前景更加難以判斷。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury announced an expansion of its bond buyback program, yet it failed to halt the rise in yields. On Wednesday the 9th, the 10‑year Treasury yield climbed to its highest level since November 2023, reflecting that the buyback size fell short of what some Wall Street participants expected and that oil prices broke the $100‑a‑barrel mark, keeping inflation‑risk concerns elevated.

The benchmark 10‑year yield rose more than 3 basis points to 4.839%, touching its highest level since November 1, 2023, when it briefly reached 4.935%. The 30‑year yield also climbed 3 basis points to 5.292%, while the 2‑year yield, which is more sensitive to short‑term policy expectations, rose just over 1 basis point to 4.415%. Bond prices move inversely to yields.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a $6 billion repurchase of long‑dated government bonds, roughly three times the size of a typical operation. Bessent had said last month that the Treasury would at least double the scale of its buybacks in order to improve market liquidity.

Nevertheless, yields kept climbing after the announcement because some investors had been hoping for a more aggressive move. Peter Boockvar of The Boock Report noted that certain Wall Street figures had originally estimated the buyback could reach $7‑8 billion, so the final amount fell short of market expectations.

Oil prices rose in tandem, adding pressure to the bond market. International benchmark Brent crude futures broke the $100‑a‑barrel level for the first time since the end of July, and U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures jumped more than 3% on Wednesday, surpassing $96 a barrel.

U.S.–Iran tensions continued to escalate. Tehran said on Wednesday that Iranian forces had attacked two U.S. vessels and eight tankers in the Persian Gulf, in retaliation for the U.S. destroying five Iranian oil tankers.

Marc Ostwald, chief economist and global strategist at ADM Investor Services, said the environment for rates and foreign‑exchange markets is becoming increasingly complex. Persistently high energy prices could widen inflationary pressures while also weighing on economic growth, potentially disrupting demand and making policy and market outlooks harder to gauge.

items.title: 貝森特最高砸60億美元回購長債！規模擴至平時3倍 美債殖利率仍不降反升
items.title_en: Bessent Announces Up to $6 Billion Treasury Buyback, Triple Normal Scale; Yields Rise Instead of Falling
paras: 美國財政部周三(9日)宣布，將回購最高60億美元的中長期政府債券，規模為一般操作的3倍，希望改善債市流動性並維持市場正常運作。然而，回購上限低於部分投資人期待，美債殖利率仍不降反升。
此次回購鎖定已發行的10年期與20年期公債，實際操作將於周四(10日)進行，時間為20分鐘，並在美東時間下午2時結束。財政部也表示，未來每次回購規模將至少達到40億美元，是一般20億美元操作的兩倍。
財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)8月19日曾宣布，財政部將把已發行公債的回購規模至少提高一倍。這項措施名義上是為長天期公債市場提供流動性，但由於美債殖利率已升至2008年全球金融危機前以來未見水準，也被市場視為試圖壓低殖利率的行動。
市場原先臆測，回購規模可能達到80億至100億美元，相當於平時的4至5倍。Wrightson ICAP分析師指出，提高至60億美元雖是顯著加碼，但大致仍符合「至少增加一倍」的說法；若直接升至80億至100億美元，將代表財政部在短短兩周內再次大幅調整債務策略，也可能讓外界認為8月的決定過於倉促。
市場對最終公布的回購上限反應負面，美債殖利率一度全面攀升，長天期殖利率最多上漲約5個基點，其後漲幅略為收斂。
指標10年期美債殖利率在美東時間上午11時30分左右升至4.841%，20年期殖利率攀抵5.314%；30年期殖利率一度上漲5個基點並突破市場關注的5.3%關卡，最新報5.307%。債券價格與殖利率呈反向變動。
美債近期面臨多重壓力，包括美國政府債務突破40兆美元、關稅與伊朗戰爭推升通膨疑慮，以及國際油價周三再度突破每桶100美元。長天期公債交易活躍度原本就低於短債，因此更容易受到賣壓及流動性變化影響。
供給持續增加也加重市場負擔。美國財政部今年公債發行規模較2025年成長11.8%，由民間持有的公債規模則增至31.8兆美元，年增8.2%。部分市場人士因此質疑，即使把回購規模提高至60億美元，相較龐大的美債市場，實際影響仍然有限。
加速回購也被批評打破財政部一向強調的政策可預測性。杜肯家族辦公室(Duquesne Family Office)負責人、貝森特昔日導師朱肯米勒(Stanley Druckenmiller)警告，一旦市場相信財政部正在捍衛特定債券價格，每次殖利率上升都會成為對官方決心的考驗，迫使回購規模不斷擴大。
他直言，政府若試圖違逆基本面、捍衛市場價格，最終總會失敗，差別只在於認輸前要付出多少代價。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury announced on Wednesday (the 9th) that it will repurchase up to $6 billion of medium‑ and long‑term government bonds, a volume three times its usual operations, aiming to improve bond‑market liquidity and keep the market functioning normally. However, the buyback ceiling fell short of some investors' expectations, and Treasury yields continued to rise rather than fall.

The buyback will target outstanding 10‑year and 20‑year notes, with the actual operation slated for Thursday (the 10th) lasting 20 minutes and ending at 2 p.m. Eastern Time. The Treasury also said future buybacks will be at least $4 billion each, double the typical $2 billion size.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced on August 19 that the Treasury would at least double the repurchase volume of outstanding notes. While the measure is nominally intended to provide liquidity to the long‑term Treasury market, it is seen by the market as an attempt to push yields down, especially as yields have climbed to levels not seen since before the 2008 global financial crisis.

The market had initially speculated the buyback could reach $8‑10 billion, roughly four to five times the normal size. Wrightson ICAP analysts noted that raising the ceiling to $6 billion is a significant increase and roughly aligns with the “at least double” pledge; jumping straight to $8‑10 billion would signal a rapid second shift in debt strategy within two weeks and could make the August decision appear hasty.
The market reacted negatively to the final announced ceiling, with Treasury yields briefly surging across the board. Long‑term yields rose as much as 5 basis points before the rally eased slightly.

The benchmark 10‑year yield rose to about 4.841% around 11:30 a.m. Eastern Time, the 20‑year climbed to 5.314%, and the 30‑year spiked 5 basis points, briefly breaking the 5.3% threshold and later reported at 5.307%. Bond prices move inversely to yields.

U.S. Treasuries have recently faced multiple pressures, including the federal debt surpassing $40 trillion, tariff‑ and Iran‑war‑driven inflation concerns, and oil prices breaking $100 per barrel again on Wednesday. Long‑dated securities are normally less actively traded than short‑dated ones, making them more vulnerable to selling pressure and liquidity shifts.

Continued supply growth also burdens the market. Treasury issuance this year is up 11.8% from 2025 levels, while privately held Treasury holdings have risen to $31.8 trillion, an 8.2% annual increase. Some market participants question that even a $6 billion buyback will have limited impact given the sheer size of the Treasury market.

Accelerating the buyback has been criticized for undermining the Treasury’s usual emphasis on policy predictability. Stanley Druckenmiller, head of the Duquesne Family Office and Bessent’s former mentor, warned that if the market believes the Treasury is defending specific bond prices, each rise in yields becomes a test of official resolve, forcing ever‑larger buybacks.
He bluntly said that when a government tries to fight fundamentals and defend market prices, it will ultimately fail, the only difference being how much it costs before it concedes.

items.title: OpenAI深化與三星戰略合作 布局下一代晶片與企業級AI服務
items.title_en: OpenAI Deepens Strategic Partnership with Samsung, Targeting Next-Gen Chips and Enterprise AI Services
paras: OpenAI 南韓區總經理 Harrison Kim 周三(9日)於首爾記者會上表示，公司正深化與三星電子在下一代晶片開發(共同生產與研究)及企業級 AI 服務上的合作，並稱三星是其在晶片領域發展最先進的合作夥伴之一。
此外，Kim 還透露三星電子是目前全球部署 ChatGPT 規模最大的企業之一，其 AI 技術已廣泛應用於研發、行銷以及銷售等多個部門。
對此，三星電子則回應無法確認與客戶相關的資訊。
OpenAI 正積極發展自研晶片，先前於 6 月公布首款與博通(AVGO-US)聯合設計的 AI 推理晶片「Jalapeno」，並由台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)負責製造。由於更先進的運算需要更高速複雜的晶片，三星與 SK 海力士(SKHY-US)去年已簽署意向書，為 OpenAI 的 Stargate 資料中心計畫供應記憶體晶片。
OpenAI 財務長 Sarah Friar 表示，公司甚至利用自身的 AI 模型來輔助開發 Jalapeño 晶片，並在短短九個月內便完成生產定案。同時，OpenAI 正將 AI 應用推廣至晶片設計、生命科學與金融領域，並嘗試採用基於成果的計費模式，以提升企業端的採用率。
在企業應用方面，三星是全球大規模部署 ChatGPT 的企業之一，員工廣泛應用於研發、行銷與銷售等業務。
此外，南韓市場發展極為迅速，截至 8 月底，南韓企業的 ChatGPT Enterprise 用戶數年增約 28 倍，更是去年底美國以外付費訂戶最多的國家。OpenAI 預期，在 9 月 4 日推出最新模型 GPT-6 Astra 後，企業採納速度將進一步加速。
paras_en: OpenAI’s South Korea regional manager Harrison Kim said on Wednesday (the 9th) at a press conference in Seoul that the company is deepening its collaboration with Samsung Electronics on next‑generation chip development (joint production and research) and enterprise‑grade AI services, calling Samsung one of its most advanced partners in the chip space.

Kim also revealed that Samsung Electronics is currently one of the world’s largest deployers of ChatGPT, with its AI technology widely used across research and development, marketing and sales departments.
Samsung responded that it could not confirm information related to the customer.

OpenAI is actively developing its own chips; in June it announced its first AI inference chip, “Jalapeño,” co‑designed with Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and manufactured by TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US). Because more advanced computing requires faster, more complex chips, Samsung and SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) signed a letter of intent last year to supply memory chips for OpenAI’s Stargate data‑center project.

Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar said the company even used its own AI models to help develop the Jalapeño chip, finalising production decisions within just nine months. At the same time, OpenAI is extending AI applications to chip design, life sciences and finance, and is experimenting with outcome‑based pricing to boost enterprise adoption.
In the enterprise arena, Samsung is one of the companies that has deployed ChatGPT at massive scale, with employees widely using it for R&D, marketing and sales activities.

South Korea’s market is growing extremely fast; by the end of August, the number of ChatGPT Enterprise users at Korean firms had increased roughly 28‑fold year‑over‑year, making the country the largest source of paid subscribers outside the United States at the end of last year. OpenAI expects that the rollout of its latest model, GPT‑6 Astra, on September 4 will further accelerate corporate adoption.

items.title_en: HeChun's August Revenue Jumps 132% YoY, Hits New Monthly High, Boosted by Rising Order Visibility and Accelerated Automation Push
paras: AI與機器人自動化解決方案專家和椿(6215-TW)今(9)日公告8月營收為8月營收4.07億元、月增7.73%、年增132.82%，不僅年月營收呈現雙增，更創下和椿單月營收新高，累計今(2026)年前8月合併營收共24.61億元，年增59.76％，和椿表示，主要受惠訂單能見度攀升，加上自動化次系統(Subsystem)設備拉貨動能持續提升，成為推動營收成長的關鍵動能。
和椿指出，8月營收維持高檔成長力道，主因歸功於半導體、高階AI伺服器、電子製造等產業客戶對於旗下Subsystem設備拉貨動能持續強勁，隨著全球 AI算力需求擴張帶動高階伺服器產能與半導體終端測試需求同步開出。
和椿強調，高密度貼片與測試系統對微米級精度及良率的要求極高，和椿憑藉在半導體測試與 SMT 設備領域累積的精密驗證標準，提供對應傳動、驅動、控制與感測相關精密零組件，並將高精度運控與即時監測技術深度整合於次系統中，深獲半導體、高階伺服器、電子製造等產業客戶的高度依賴與肯定，成為推升公司營收規模穩健擴大的核心引擎，整體訂單金額與能見度也逐步增高。

據全球AI巨頭輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳指出，AI 的下一波浪潮是 Physical AI(物理AI)，AI正加速從螢幕內的文本與圖像，走向能感知、會行動、能執行複雜任務的真實世界，從輝達 揭露的Physical AI版圖可清晰看出，機器人產業的競爭核心已由傳統的單一硬體零部件，演進為「算力、模型、數據與本體協同」的全方位整合，和椿也密切關注此一技術發展趨勢，並規劃投入人形機器人等具身智慧軟硬體整合服務之布局。
展望未來，隨著Physical AI打開機器人新一輪基礎設施需求。和椿表示，對中長期營運抱持樂觀態度，公司持續發揮「半導體高階次系統」與「AI 機器人」雙軌並進的綜效，不僅深耕半導體關鍵製程與潔淨室等級 AMR 部署，並持續優化軟硬體協同能力，穩健推進全球機器人商業化落地進程，為股東與客戶創造長期永續價值。
paras_en: HeChun (6215-TW), a specialist in AI and robotic automation solutions, announced today (Sept. 9) that its August revenue reached NT$4.07 billion, up 7.73% month‑over‑month and 132.82% year‑over‑year. Not only did both monthly and yearly revenues grow, the figure also set a new single‑month revenue record for HeChun. Cumulative consolidated revenue for the first eight months of 2026 totaled NT$24.61 billion, a 59.76% increase year‑over‑year. HeChun said the growth was mainly driven by higher order visibility and continued momentum in pulling Subsystem automation equipment, which became the key engine for revenue expansion.

HeChun noted that August’s strong growth was primarily due to robust demand from semiconductor, high‑end AI server, and electronics manufacturing customers for its Subsystem equipment. As global AI compute demand expands, it fuels both high‑end server capacity and semiconductor end‑test needs, sustaining the pull‑in momentum.

HeChun emphasized that high‑density placement and testing systems require micron‑level precision and yield. Leveraging its precision verification standards accumulated in semiconductor testing and SMT equipment, the company supplies precision components for transmission, drive, control and sensing, and deeply integrates high‑accuracy motion control and real‑time monitoring technologies into its Subsystems. This has earned strong reliance and recognition from semiconductor, high‑end server and electronics manufacturing customers, becoming the core engine for steady revenue scaling, with overall order amounts and visibility gradually increasing.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang said the next wave of AI is “Physical AI,” where AI moves from screen‑based text and images to perceiving, acting and executing complex tasks in the real world. Nvidia’s disclosed Physical AI roadmap shows that competition in the robotics industry is shifting from traditional single‑hardware parts to a holistic integration of compute, models, data and embodiment. HeChun is closely monitoring this trend and plans to invest in embodied intelligence services, including humanoid robots that combine hardware and software.

Looking ahead, HeChun is optimistic about mid‑ to long‑term operations as Physical AI opens a new round of infrastructure demand for robotics. The company will continue to harness the synergistic effect of its “high‑end semiconductor Subsystems” and “AI robotics” dual‑track strategy, deepening semiconductor key‑process and clean‑room‑grade AMR deployments while enhancing hardware‑software co‑optimization, steadily advancing global robot commercialization and creating sustainable long‑term value for shareholders and customers.

items.title: 迎戰50年後人口減半！國發會祭3大處方：長靠出生、中靠升級、短靠「外」援
items.title_en: Facing a Population Halving in 50 Years! The National Development Council Prescribes Three Strategies: Long‑term Births, Mid‑term Upgrading, Short‑term "Foreign" Aid
paras: 面對少子化與高齡化雙重浪潮衝擊，台灣正迎來前所未有的人才斷層危機。國發會人力發展處長謝佳宜今(9)日於台灣女董事協會「2026剛柔並濟大未來」論壇中示警，根據國發會日前公布最新 50 年人口推估，台灣總人口在 50 年後將大減 48%、僅剩約 1,215 萬人；其中 15 至 64 歲的工作年齡人口更將銳減 67%，且結構嚴重高齡化。面對人口紅利即將耗盡的嚴峻現實，企業唯有走向「全齡共融」，方能在人才變局中穩住陣腳。
謝佳宜指出，台灣去年生育率已跌至 0.695（約 0.7）的超低水準，伴隨不婚、晚婚與生育年齡延後，可生育的育齡婦女人數持續縮減。針對外界關注的人口紅利期，她特別澄清：「人口紅利看似延後兩年，絕非值得高興的事，而是因為出生數減少過快、分母變小的數學結果。」預估至 2061 年，65 歲以上老齡人口將正式超越工作年齡人口。
面對缺工擴大，政府已啟動跨部會「人口對策新戰略」。謝佳宜總結三大核心藥方：「長遠來看靠促進生育；中長期靠培育升級與提升勞動力；短中期則靠引進外國人才。」她強調，提升婦女與中高齡勞動參與率是解開缺工鎖鏈的關鍵。為此，政府正擴大彈性工時、育嬰留停補助及企業托育支援，致力打造友善職場，讓女性不再被迫在「工作與家庭」之間做出二擇一的殘酷抉擇。
「企業若能成為支持員工家庭的最強後盾，自然能突破人口變遷帶來的考驗。」謝佳宜呼籲，在少子化時代，企業應主動擁抱女力與中高齡人才，以「全齡共融」的新思維重塑營運韌性，共同化解人才斷層危機。
paras_en: Facing the twin waves of low fertility and aging, Taiwan is confronting an unprecedented talent gap crisis. Xie Jiayi, director of the Human Resources Development Division of the National Development Council, warned today (the 9th) at the Taiwan Women Directors Association’s “2026 Balanced Future” forum that, according to the council’s latest 50‑year population projection, Taiwan’s total population will shrink by 48% in half a century to about 12.15 million. The working‑age population (15‑64) will plunge 67%, and the age structure will become severely aged. With the demographic dividend about to run out, companies must adopt an “all‑age inclusive” approach to steady themselves amid the talent upheaval.

Xie noted that Taiwan’s fertility rate fell to an ultra‑low 0.695 (about 0.7) last year, and together with trends of non‑marriage, later marriage and delayed child‑bearing, the number of women of child‑bearing age continues to shrink. Responding to public concern about the demographic dividend, she clarified: “The dividend may appear to be delayed by two years, but that is not a cause for celebration; it is simply a mathematical result of births falling too fast and the denominator getting smaller.” She projects that by 2061 the population aged 65 and over will finally outnumber the working‑age population.

Confronted with widening labor shortages, the government has launched a cross‑agency “New Population Strategy.” Xie summarized three core prescriptions: “In the long run, boost births; in the medium‑term, cultivate upskilling and raise labor participation; in the short‑to‑medium term, attract foreign talent.” She stressed that raising women’s and older‑workers’ participation rates is key to unlocking the labor‑shortage lock. To that end, the government is expanding flexible work hours, childcare leave subsidies and corporate childcare support, aiming to create a family‑friendly workplace so women no longer have to make a cruel choice between “work and family.”

“If companies can become the strongest back‑stop for employees’ families, they will naturally overcome the challenges posed by demographic change,” Xie urged. In an era of low fertility, firms should proactively embrace female and older talent, reshaping operational resilience with an “all‑age inclusive” mindset to jointly resolve the talent gap crisis.

items.title: 外資大買面板雙虎、倒貨金融股 三大法人合計買超220億元
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Heavily Buy Panel Tigers, Dump Financial Stocks; Three Major Institutional Investors Net Bought 22 Billion TWD
paras: 台股今(9)日開高後一度大漲超過440點，尾盤呈現高檔震盪後收紅走勢，終場收在47,183點，上漲77點，成交量較昨日縮減至7,735億元。據證交所盤後資訊顯示，外資今日加碼買超209.24億元，看好面板股在本(9)月上旬面板價格預測將隨著年底促銷旺季備貨需求回溫，掃進群創(3481-TW)8.1萬張、友達(2049-TW) 6.5萬張，也買進主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)等2檔主動式ETF操作。
觀察今日三大法人動向，外資單日買超209.24億元、投信加碼買超 30.4億元、自營商賣超18.84億元，三大法人合計買超 220.81億元。外資期貨部分，外資空單減少1,196口，累計期貨空單仍高達8.1萬口。
在外資今日動向上，買超前10名中，以群創位居首位8.19萬張最高、友達6.57萬張，主動統一台股增長 1.94萬張、新纖1.79萬張、台泥1.74萬張、聯電1.46萬張、臺企銀1.33萬張、台塑化1.32萬張，廣達及台塑各自買超約1.3萬張。
外資賣超前10名中，共6檔為金融股，賣超最多為華邦電5.79萬張、台新新光金3.24萬張、凱基金2.19萬張、玉山金2萬張、彰銀12.9萬張，台中銀及1.17萬張、中信金1.13萬張、至上 9,362張、沛爾生醫*-創6,626張、復華富時不動產(00712-TW) 6,111張。
投信買超前10名中則有6家為金融股，與外資對作，買最多為台新新光金2.03萬張、其次為凱基金8,068 張、聯電5,044張、玉山金3,131張、統一證2,228張、至上1,986張、第一金1,612張、台勝科1,401張、中信金1,348 張、興富發1,342 張。
投信賣超前10名中，以華通4,529張賣最多、其次遠東新2,297張、遠東銀2,253張、緯創1,865張、群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)1,800張、聯鈞1,406張、緯穎1,016張，其後依序為光寶科、微星、智邦。
法人表示，以技術面來看，台股今日開高後一路向上到近昨(8)日高點，但未能有效突破，隨後一路走低至接近平盤，顯示4萬7,500點仍是明顯壓力區，以整體趨勢結構觀察，加權指數收盤仍守短、中、長期均線之上，均線排列尚未轉弱，代表中期多頭格局暫時沒有遭到破壞，只要回檔未跌破短期均線及4萬7千點整數關卡，仍可視為漲多後的技術性整理，而非趨勢反轉訊號。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks opened higher today (the 9th) and surged over 440 points at one point, ending the session with a high‑range oscillation and a red close, finishing at 47,183 points, up 77 points, with turnover shrinking to TWD 7.735 trillion. Post‑market data from the exchange shows foreign investors increased net buying by TWD 20.924 billion, optimistic that panel stock prices in early September will rebound with year‑end promotional season inventory demand, while upstream component costs remain high, snapping up 81,000 lots of Innolux (3481‑TW) and 65,000 lots of AU Optronics (2049‑TW), and also purchasing two active ETFs: Unified Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) and Unified Taiwan Stock Growth (00981A‑TW).

Observing today’s three major institutional investors, foreign investors net bought TWD 20.924 billion, investment trusts added net buying of TWD 3.04 billion, while dealers sold net TWD 1.884 billion, totaling a net purchase of TWD 22.081 billion. In the futures segment, foreign investors reduced short positions by 1,196 contracts, but cumulative futures shorts remain high at 81,000 contracts.

Among the top ten net‑buy stocks by foreign investors, Innolux led with 81,900 lots, followed by AU Optronics with 65,700 lots, Unified Taiwan Stock Growth with 19,400 lots, New Fiber with 17,900 lots, Taiwan Cement with 17,400 lots, United Microelectronics with 14,600 lots, Taiwan Business Bank with 13,300 lots, Formosa Plastics Corp. (chemical) with 13,200 lots, and both Quanta Computer and Formosa Plastics Corp. (chemical) each net bought about 13,000 lots.

In the foreign investors’ top ten net‑sell list, six were financial stocks. The biggest seller was Winbond Electronics with 57,900 lots, followed by Taishin Financial Holding & Shin Kong Financial with 32,400 lots, KGI Securities with 21,900 lots, E.SUN Financial Holding with 20,000 lots, Chang Hwa Bank with 12,900 lots, Taichung Bank with 11,700 lots, CTBC Financial Holding with 11,300 lots, Shang Shin with 9,362 lots, Pei Er Biotech‑Chuang with 6,626 lots, and Fuhua FT Real Estate (00712‑TW) with 6,111 lots.

Among the top ten net‑buy stocks by investment trusts, six were financial stocks, mirroring foreign investors’ moves. The biggest buyer was Taishin Financial Holding & Shin Kong Financial with 20,300 lots, followed by KGI Securities with 8,068 lots, United Microelectronics with 5,044 lots, E.SUN Financial Holding with 3,131 lots, Uni-President Securities with 2,228 lots, Shang Shin with 1,986 lots, First Financial Holding with 1,612 lots, Tai Sheng Technology with 1,401 lots, CTBC Financial Holding with 1,348 lots, and Xing Fu Development with 1,342 lots.

In the investment trusts’ top ten net‑sell list, the biggest seller was Wistron with 4,529 lots, followed by Far Eastern New Century with 2,297 lots, Far Eastern Bank with 2,253 lots, Wistron with 1,865 lots, Yuanta Taiwan High‑Yield Selection (00919‑TW) with 1,800 lots, Lianjun with 1,406 lots, Wistron with 1,016 lots, and then Lite‑On Technology, MSI, and ZyXEL each sold notable amounts.

Institutional commentary noted that technically, the market opened higher and rose toward yesterday’s (the 8th) high but failed to break through, then fell back toward the flat line, indicating that the 47,500‑point level remains a clear resistance zone. Looking at the overall trend structure, the index closed still above the short‑, medium‑ and long‑term moving averages, whose arrangement has not weakened, suggesting the medium‑term bullish pattern remains intact. As long as any pullback does not breach the short‑term average and the 47,000‑point round‑number level, the move can be seen as a technical consolidation after the rally rather than a trend‑reversal signal.
